enums.name: TextureFormat
enums.docs: A texture's internal format, OpenGL ES's values.

enums.name: BufferTarget
enums.docs: The binding target a buffer is created for, OpenGL ES's values.

enums.name: Usage
enums.docs: A buffer's usage hint, OpenGL ES's values.

enums.name: Filter
enums.docs: A sampler's filter, OpenGL ES's values.

enums.name: Wrap
enums.docs: A sampler's wrap mode, OpenGL ES's values.

enums.name: Primitive
enums.docs: A draw's primitive, OpenGL ES's values.

enums.name: ComponentType
enums.docs: A vertex attribute's or index's component type, OpenGL ES's values.

enums.name: ClearBits
enums.docs: `Context.clear` bits, OpenGL ES's values, or-ed together.

records.name: Blend
records.docs:
`Blend` sets how what is drawn blends into the target. The factors are hxn-gpu's shared
codes, from 0 `Zero` to 10 `SrcAlphaSaturated`, and the operations are the codes from 0 `Add`
to 4 `Max`. When `enabled` is false, drawing writes its color as it is.

interfaces.name: Display
interfaces.docs: An EGL display: the connection contexts are made on.

methods.name: headless
methods.docs:
A display that needs no window system: Mesa's surfaceless platform where EGL has it,
else the default display.

methods.name: native
methods.docs:
The display of a window system: `platform` is an EGL platform, such as
`EGL_PLATFORM_X11_KHR` (0x31D5) or `EGL_PLATFORM_WAYLAND_KHR` (0x31D8), and `native`
that platform's display, which hxn-window's `raw` gives. Platform 0 takes `native` as
an `EGLNativeDisplayType`, and 0 there is the default display.

methods.name: vendor
methods.docs: EGL's vendor string.

methods.name: version
methods.docs: EGL's version string.

methods.name: extensions
methods.docs: The display's EGL extensions, separated by spaces.

methods.name: create_context
methods.docs:
An OpenGL ES 3 context with no default framebuffer: it renders into framebuffers alone.
It is current on the calling thread.

methods.name: create_window_context
methods.docs:
An OpenGL ES 3 context whose default framebuffer is the window `window`, an
`EGLNativeWindowType`: an `ANativeWindow*` on Android, an X11 window on Xlib. `visual`
is the window's X11 visual id, which picks a config of that visual; 0 takes any. With
hxn-window on Xlib they are `raw(0)` and `raw(1)`. It is current on the calling
thread.

methods.name: create_wayland_context
methods.docs:
A context whose default framebuffer is a Wayland window: `surface` is its `wl_surface`,
which hxn-window's `raw(0)` gives, on a display from `native(0x31D8, raw(2))`
(`EGL_PLATFORM_WAYLAND_KHR`). `Context.resizeWindow` follows the window's size.

interfaces.name: Context
interfaces.docs:
An OpenGL ES 3 context. Its methods are OpenGL ES's, called on the thread where it is
current.

methods.name: resize_window
methods.docs:
Sets the size of the window the default framebuffer is, where EGL takes it from the
program rather than the window system: Wayland. Elsewhere it does nothing.

methods.name: make_current
methods.docs: Makes the context current on the calling thread.

methods.name: swap_buffers
methods.docs: Presents the window's back buffer, for a context made with `createWindowContext`.

methods.name: swap_interval
methods.docs: The number of vertical blanks `swapBuffers` waits for: 0 presents at once.

methods.name: renderer
methods.docs: `GL_RENDERER`.

methods.name: version
methods.docs: `GL_VERSION`.

methods.name: extensions
methods.docs: `GL_EXTENSIONS`, separated by spaces.

methods.name: error
methods.docs: `glGetError`: 0, or the first error since the last call.

methods.name: create_buffer
methods.docs: A buffer of `size` bytes, uninitialized, for `target`.

methods.name: create_buffer_with
methods.docs: A buffer holding `bytes`, for `target`.

methods.name: create_texture
methods.docs: A 2D texture of one level, with immutable storage.

methods.name: create_sampler
methods.docs: A sampler with these filters and wrap modes.

methods.name: create_program
methods.docs:
A program linked from GLSL ES 3.00 vertex and fragment sources. Compile and link
errors are thrown with OpenGL ES's log.

methods.name: create_vertex_array
methods.docs: An empty vertex array.

methods.name: create_framebuffer
methods.docs: A framebuffer rendering into `color`. Throws unless it is complete.

methods.name: bind_framebuffer
methods.docs: Renders into `framebuffer` from now on.

methods.name: bind_default_framebuffer
methods.docs: Renders into the window from now on.

methods.name: scissor_test
methods.docs:
Turns the scissor test on or off: `glEnable` or `glDisable` of `GL_SCISSOR_TEST`.
While it is on, drawing, clearing and copies stay inside the `scissor` rectangle.

methods.name: blit_flipped
methods.docs:
Copies the `width` by `height` color of `framebuffer` into the window with its rows
reversed, then renders into the window. The scissor test must be off.

methods.name: clear
methods.docs:
Clears the bound framebuffer's color, depth or stencil: `bits` are `ClearBits` or-ed
together.

methods.name: set_blend
methods.docs:
Sets how what is drawn next blends into the target. It calls `glEnable(GL_BLEND)` with
`glBlendEquationSeparate` and `glBlendFuncSeparate`, or `glDisable(GL_BLEND)`.

methods.name: bind_uniform_buffer
methods.docs: Binds `buffer` to uniform buffer binding point `index`.

methods.name: bind_texture
methods.docs: Binds `texture` and `sampler` to texture unit `unit`.

methods.name: draw_arrays
methods.docs: `glDrawArraysInstanced`.

methods.name: draw_elements
methods.docs:
`glDrawElementsInstanced`, with indices from the bound vertex array's element buffer,
starting `offset` bytes in.

methods.name: read_pixels
methods.docs: The bound framebuffer's pixels in a rectangle, as 8-bit RGBA, bottom row first.

methods.name: flush
methods.docs: `glFlush`.

methods.name: finish
methods.docs: `glFinish`: returns when the GPU has finished every command so far.

methods.name: completed
methods.docs:
Settles when the GPU has finished every command so far. It waits on an EGL fence from
another thread; without EGL 1.5 and `EGL_KHR_fence_sync` it finishes here and is settled
already.

methods.name: write
methods.docs: Writes `bytes` at `offset`.

methods.name: read
methods.docs:
Reads `length` bytes at `offset`, mapping the buffer. It waits for the GPU to finish
writing them.

methods.name: write
methods.docs: Writes a rectangle of pixels, rows tightly packed, bottom row first.

methods.name: uniform_block
methods.docs:
Assigns the uniform block `name` to binding point `binding`. False when the program
has no such block.

methods.name: sampler
methods.docs:
Assigns the sampler uniform `name` to texture unit `unit`. False when the program has
no such uniform. It leaves this program in use.

interfaces.name: VertexArray
interfaces.docs: A vertex array: attribute layouts and the buffers they read, and an element buffer.

methods.name: attribute
methods.docs:
Attribute `location` reads `size` components of `kind` from `buffer`, `stride` bytes
apart from `offset`, as floats; integer components become floats, scaled to 0-1 or
-1-1 when `normalized`.

methods.name: integer_attribute
methods.docs:
Attribute `location` reads `size` integer components of `kind`, for an `int` or
`uint` input.

methods.name: divisor
methods.docs: Attribute `location` advances once per `divisor` instances; 0 advances per vertex.

methods.name: element_buffer
methods.docs: The buffer `drawElements` reads indices from.
